cases.case_label: Inverted Alu insertion in exon 3 of POMT1 (French)
cases.mechanism_detail: An inverted Alu inserted within exon 3 of POMT1, found in five WWS fetuses (four heterozygous, one homozygous) on a shared haplotype with p.Arg735Cys; effect on transcript/protein not investigated, coding disruption inferred.
cases.quote: The five fetuses were found to share an insertion of an inversed Alu repeated DNA element within exon 3 of the POMT1 gene
